title: 第28章 又要解锁新技能
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
赵玉兰觉得时间安排得太紧凑，直到送魏建业出家门时还在唠叨:“眼袋都垂到嘴巴边了，睡一觉再出门能咋的！”

    魏建业迎着媳妇不赞同的目光笑着说：“昨晚全员就属我最轻松，一点都不累，正好去主岛把这件大好事上报给领导。”

    蔡老太插话：“他也着急去买锅盖。”

    赵玉兰眼神就柔和了许多，嫁人不就是图个事事有回应，处处有着落么。

    丈夫记得家里头缺少个锅盖，做到这份子上她就满足了。

    魏建业肉眼可见地瞧见媳妇的转变，感激地瞅着亲妈，心想今儿就是亲自生也得拿回来一个锅盖！

    按着婆媳俩的推测，撇去往返路上以及办事花费的时间，应该能赶上吃晌午饭。

    可直到下午还不见魏建业回家，惹得赵玉兰频频到门口张望。

    总算瞧见丈夫身影后，她激动地朝屋里头喊了一声，“妈，回来了！”

    魏建业扛着一块木料精神抖擞地走进院子里，心花怒放地说：“领导说会派自来水厂的水质检测员过来，还说要奖励咱们这一户三斤猪肉。”

    边擦手边走出来的蔡老太笑眯了眼。

    搁城里头每人每个月也就半斤的猪肉定量，三斤真不少了！

    魏建业也笑得露牙花子，“我今儿一上主岛，逢人就说咱们岛上也有水，往后就不用天天眼巴巴的去排队取水，可把别人羡慕坏了。

    服务社没锅盖，我寻思着弄一块杉木回来自己做，那些人非要搭把手，说是顺道一块过来参观水井。”

    他是归心似箭所以走得快，这会其他送木料的人应该快到了。

    赵玉兰急切地对婆婆说：“哎呀妈，还真来啊，咱家还没收拾呢。”

    婆媳俩放眼望去打量了眼已经相当整洁的家和院子，最后又对视了一眼，同时慌慌张张地动起来。

    赵玉兰把院子里晒着的衣服一股脑全薅下来塞进衣柜里，这样院子里亮堂好看。

    她又张罗着把叠好的被子重新叠一遍，然后蹲在地上捡头发。

    蔡老太已经开始疯狂打扫庭院，屋门都得擦一遍，犄角旮旯的地儿都得瞅瞅有没有灰，然后使唤大儿子把墙角的柴火堆重新垒出造型来，主打一个体面和不让人笑话。

    要是时间还充足，魏建业就该擦屋顶了。

    全家都做到这份子上了，等真来人了却一个劲地说：“来来来，屋里坐，家里脏得很，几天没打扫啦~”

    大部分人都是奔着参观岛上的水井来的，但听说送木料的人要去找到水源的当事人家里，又纷纷决定一块过来凑凑热闹。
content_en:
Zhao Yulan felt that the schedule was too tight, and she was still nagging until she sent Wei Jianye out of the house: "The bags under my eyes are hanging down to my mouth, what can I do if I take a nap before going out!"

    Wei Jianye faced his wife's disapproving look and said with a smile: "I was the most relaxed last night. I was not tired at all. I just happened to go to the main island to report this good thing to the leader."

    Mrs. Cai interjected: "He is also anxious to buy a pot lid."

    Zhao Yulan's eyes softened a lot. Isn't the purpose of marrying someone to be responsive to everything and have everything in place?

    The husband remembered that there was a lack of a pot lid at home, so she was satisfied with this job.

    Wei Jianye saw the change in his wife with his naked eyes, and looked at his mother with gratitude, thinking that even if he gave birth today, he would have to get a pot lid back!

    According to the speculations of the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, excluding the time spent traveling to and from the place and doing errands, they should be able to make it in time for lunch.

    But Wei Jianye hadn't come home until the afternoon, which made Zhao Yulan frequently look at the door.

    After finally seeing her husband, she excitedly shouted into the room, "Mom, you're back!"

    Wei Jianye walked into the yard energetically carrying a piece of wood and said happily: "The leader said he would send water quality inspectors from the water plant over, and he also said he would reward our household with three kilograms of pork."

    Mrs. Cai, who came out while wiping her hands, smiled and narrowed her eyes.

    In the city, the ration of pork is only half a catty per person per month. Three catties is really a lot!

    Wei Jianye also smiled toothily, "As soon as I went to the main island today, I told everyone I met that there is water on our island. From now on, I don't have to queue up to get water every day, which makes others envious."

    There was no pot lid at the service station, so I thought about getting a piece of fir wood to make it myself. Those people insisted on helping me, saying that we were stopping by to visit the well. "

    He walked quickly because he was eager to get home. The other people delivering wood should be arriving soon.

    Zhao Yulan said eagerly to her mother-in-law: "Oh Mom, you are really here, our house hasn't been cleaned up yet."

    The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law looked around at the already quite tidy home and yard, and finally looked at each other, and at the same time started to move in a panic.

    Zhao Yulan collected all the clothes that were drying in the yard and stuffed them into the closet, so that the yard would be bright and beautiful.

    She unfolded the folded quilt and folded it again, then squatted on the ground to pick up her hair.

    Mrs. Cai had already started cleaning the courtyard like crazy. She had to wipe the door of the house and check every corner for dust. She then ordered her eldest son to reshape the pile of firewood in the corner to make it look decent and not make people laugh.

    If there was still enough time, Wei Jianye would wipe the roof.

    The whole family has worked hard for this job, but when someone came, they kept saying: "Come on, come on, sit in the house, the house is very dirty, it hasn't been cleaned in a few days~"

    Most people came here to visit the wells on the island, but when they heard that the people delivering the wood were going to find the water source, they all decided to come over and join in the fun.
title_en: Chapter 28 Another new skill to unlock
